This job is fixture data, not a live listing (preview: the owner's photo of the garment stands in for the render). Say so plainly in one sentence that contains the English word "fixture". Write the text in Hindi (Devanagari script).

Seller's description:
- Description: shirt (short sleeves, button front), black and grey
